blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp has dropped a Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) official from its witness list before the Senate Impeachment Court, prompting the prosecution to raise concerns over the move in connection with her alleged dollar accounts. Defense team spokesperson Michael Poa explained that the testimony of BPI senior vice president Atty. Paul Roderick Ysmael was no longer necessary because its sole purpose was to “authenticate” a letter that Poa had already admitted writing during the court’s interpellation. “I believe the record should bear that during interpellation I was already asked about the letter and […]...
